result.summary: The pedestrian environment is an industrial corridor with narrow sidewalks and no dedicated crossing infrastructure. Construction barrels on the right and parked vehicles on the left create physical and visual obstructions, while blank building frontages limit natural surveillance.

hazards.name: Construction barrels
hazards.description: Barrels on the right side obstruct the narrow walkway and force pedestrians closer to the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway and sidewalk edge

hazards.name: Lack of lane markings
hazards.description: The absence of clear lane markings may lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning, increasing risk for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway

hazards.name: Blank frontage
hazards.description: The long, windowless wall of the industrial building on the left reduces natural surveillance and creates a monotonous environment.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, the large industrial building

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks to provide safe crossing points in this industrial area.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant trees along the sidewalk to provide a buffer from traffic and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a degraded sidewalk with significant physical obstructions, including construction barrels and debris. The area has an industrial character with chain-link fencing and blank frontages, offering minimal comfort or protection for people walking.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Construction barrels, a large black pipe, and wooden planks are placed directly in the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center-left on the sidewalk

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is cracked, uneven, and contains unpaved dirt sections, creating tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center foreground

hazards.name: Desolate Industrial Environment
hazards.description: Long stretches of chain-link fence and blank frontage reduce natural surveillance and pedestrian comfort.
hazards.location_in_image: Middle ground across the entire width

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Clearance
interventions.description: Remove all construction debris and non-permanent obstructions; repave the walkway to provide a continuous, level surface.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or street trees to provide a buffer between the walkway and the industrial lot, improving the microclimate and visual appeal.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add frequent, pedestrian-oriented lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety in an industrial area.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While sidewalks are present on both sides, they are obstructed by utility poles and interrupted by a large commercial driveway on the left.

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: A large wooden utility pole is situated in the middle of the sidewalk, significantly narrowing the clear walking path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground sidewalk

hazards.name: Wide Commercial Driveway
hazards.description: A wide curb cut for a building material store creates a large conflict zone where vehicles cross the pedestrian walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street, mid-ground

hazards.name: Visual Clutter
hazards.description: Numerous utility poles and overhead wires create visual clutter that may distract drivers or obscure pedestrian visibility.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the upper half of the image

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the intersection to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles to a dedicated furniture zone or underground the utilities to provide a clear, unobstructed pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Narrow or consolidate the wide commercial driveway to reduce the conflict area and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a mid-block section of an urban sidewalk adjacent to a large industrial or warehouse building. A large SUV is parked at the curb, creating a significant visual obstruction between the sidewalk and the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large SUV parked at the curb blocks sightlines between the sidewalk and the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, obscuring the street view

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracks and uneven surfaces on the concrete sidewalk present a minor trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the sidewalk area

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the concrete walkway to eliminate cracks and uneven joints.

interventions.title: Street Trees or Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street furniture zone to provide physical and psychological separation from the roadway.
